post.title: [Hiring] Technical co-builder for a B2B MVP - flexible compensation
post.body: We are two founders building a scheduling tool for physiotherapy clinics. Need a full-stack dev (React + Node) to build the MVP over ~6 weeks. Compensation is flexible and can be discussed: part cash, part something else. We have 3 clinics ready to pilot.

analysis.summary: Full-stack MVP (React/Node) for a physiotherapy-clinic scheduling tool over about 6 weeks; compensation vague, three pilot clinics lined up.

expect: asks about the compensation or scope with one easy question
mentions the scheduling tool or clinics
